newsitem.title: USA: MAF Bancorp sees Q1 $8.7 mln SAIF charge. [CORRECTED 17:56 GMT]
newsitem.headline: MAF Bancorp sees Q1 $8.7 mln SAIF charge. [CORRECTED 17:56 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to make clear story refers to first quarter and not third.)

MAF Bancorp Inc said Wednesday it will take a one-time after-tax charge of about $8.7 million in the first quarter as a result of legislation to recapitalize the Savings Association Insurance Fund (SAIF).
It said the charge will be equal to about $0.81 per share.

MAF Bancorp said it will benefit from substantially lower deposit insurance premiums in future periods. It said the reduction is expected to result in annual after-tax premium savings for the bank of about $2.3 million.
It said the charge will not have a material impact on its capital-to-assets ratios.
MAF is the parent company of Mid America Federal Savings Bank.
